synopsis: Across the compared credibility frameworks, VVUQ is part of a risk-scaled process requiring a defined context of use, physical-data validation, quantified uncertainty, independent review and a documented validity envelope [f186, f7525, f7595]. Verification checks implementation against the mathematics, validation checks representation of the real application, and neither replaces uncertainty quantification; calibration to a test is not validation [f10601, f14532, f14535]. For heavy off-road collision mitigation, the booklet recommends separate results for sensors, machine dynamics, brake actuation, environment and system timing, with remaining uncertainty smaller than the decision’s safety margin; otherwise, improve the model, narrow its envelope or add physical tests [f14539, f14537]. The illustrative roadmap places correlation, V&V and uncertainty quantification in February–March 2027, producing a pilot evidence package and model-credibility assessment before an April credibility gate [f9654, f9871]. NASA-STD-7009B, dated 5 March 2024, is a cited foundation, but the research did not verify AIAA G-077, ASME V&V 10 or ASME V&V 20, despite discussing ASME V&V 10 elsewhere [f10599, f7632, f9748]. Evidence gaps remain: few sensor-realism studies report uncertainty bands, and NIOSH identifies continuing gaps in simulation procedures and environmental validation [f4838, f10883].

relations.note: Both identify the shared core requirements of simulation-credibility frameworks.
Both describe decision-focused credibility assessment, uncertainty, independent review and limits of applicability.
Both state NASA and ASME require validation against reality.
Real-application validation, rather than internal consistency, is the shared requirement.
Both recommend separate VVUQ results for the same five subsystem areas.
Both distinguish implementation correctness, real-world fidelity and remaining uncertainty.
The model-risk grid specifies how risk-scaled credibility goals are agreed.
Non-substitutability motivates separating verification, validation, sensitivity analysis and acceptance criteria.
Calibration is not validation, supporting discrepancy updates instead of silent tuning.
Average agreement can conceal uncertainty exceeding the residual safe-distance margin.
Adds the decision rule and corrective actions when uncertainty exceeds the margin.
Uncertain test data explain why discrepancy significance depends on experimental and numerical uncertainty.
Missing sensor uncertainty bands reinforce the need to document uncertainty and sensitivity.
Out-of-domain use risk motivates physically established boundaries for independent validation.
Specifies 2027 dates and exit evidence for the roadmap’s February–March credibility work.
Adds input pedigree, robustness, history, process and people to NASA credibility assessment.
ASME V&V 10 is used as guidance despite not being verified by the research.
Adds scenario uncertainty and explicit output uncertainty to the proposed credibility review.
